system.description: You rewrite a person's life story with a quill made from a wraith's finger. Whatever the result, roll a d2 afterwards: on a 1, the fiction bleeds into your own mind and you lose this ritual.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you may rewrite two years.
outcomes.success: You permanently rewrite one year of the person's memory. You can make an enemy believe you are a lifelong friend, or a king believe he gave up his throne.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the ink will not take.
outcomes.ruin: You rewrite your own year instead. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
